title: Move and Play Letters
hook: Choose the verb that fits the sport.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D preschool sports storybook, safe gear, simple active scenes; visual identity: Move and Play Letters

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child matching movement verbs to sport objects
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: function plus correct motion, with non-movement exceptions
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: motion-neutral retrieval -> exact target -> safe gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Move and Play Letters a movement-quality song: throw, roll, glide, kick, pass, balance, float, stop and signal are differentiated, while medal/uniform/Xylophone remain non-movement comparison cards.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child chooses a movement verb only when the object truly supports it and accepts that some mapped items are organizational or symbolic.
